messages:
sahil: paging — seeing a sudden spike of 429s from production customers, GPU pool 'hotpath-gpu-a' at 100% usage and autoscaler not spinning up. queue depth is climbing fast. tagging oncall.

incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED INC-2026-0421 - GPU saturation + autoscale stall. Severity: P1. Paging oncall: @oncall. Links: https://console.redwood/incident/INC-2026-0421

oncall: I'm on it, looking at dashboards now. can someone paste the hotpath pool config?

jamie: quick snapshot — autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts failing with "scale quota exceeded" and a couple of 409s from allocation service. Token-bucket metrics for Tier=gold show refill_rate dropped to 0.3 units/s (normally 2.5).

marta: adding logs — paste from last 5m:

```
# autoscaler stderr
2026-04-21T09:12:03Z scale_attempt id=8f2 status=failed reason="allocation_quota_exhausted"
2026-04-21T09:12:15Z scale_attempt id=8f3 status=failed reason="allocation_quota_exhausted"
# tokenbucket monitor
2026-04-21T09:11:50Z tier=gold refill=0.3 burst=10 tokens=2
2026-04-21T09:12:05Z tier=silver refill=1.8 burst=20 tokens=12
```
\neli: looks like a config flip — yesterday's rollout to the new "burstmeter" feature accidentally set gold tier refill to 0.3 in prod. it matches the recent deploy.

sahil: confirm what customers are affected — console shows increased error rates across three customer orgs, mostly high-traffic API keys. sending status notes.

incidents-bot: Notifying customers with >5% error rate. Emails queued to: acme-corp, flypay, studybox.

jamie: immediate mitigation options: 1) manual override token refill for gold tier to 2.5, 2) temporarily move gold traffic to silver tier routing, 3) manual scale-up of dedicated GPU nodes (if allocation quota allows), 4) route heavy requests to cheaper model-variant with lower GPU footprint.

oncall: allocate steps: i'll try 1 and 3 in parallel. who can run the token override?

marta: i can patch tokenbucket via admin console. command below — will set refill to 2.5 and burst=40 for gold:

```
# admin console CLI
redwood-admin tokenbucket update --tier gold --refill 2.5 --burst 40 --reason "prod emergency - refill override"
```

eli: i'm opening a manual scale request now: POST /api/inventory/allocations { pool: "hotpath-gpu-a", delta: 4, priority: emergency } — hitting the allocation quota, but i'll request escalation to infra quota team.

sahil: customer-facing note (draft) — "We are investigating elevated 429 errors due to a capacity misconfiguration after a deploy. Our on-call team is actively mitigating and we'll provide updates every 15 minutes." i'll post to status.redwood shortly.

incidents-bot: update logged: mitigation actions started.

[6m later]

marta: tokenbucket override applied. gold refill now 2.5, burst 40. verified metrics reporting 

```
# tokenbucket status
tier=gold refill=2.5 burst=40 tokens=27
```

jamie: after refill bump we see immediate drop in 429s for a subset of keys — overall 429 rate down ~35% but queue depth still elevated.

eli: allocation request returned partial success: +2 nodes added, +2 pending due to quota. autoscaler still tries to add more but is rate-limited by allocation API.

sahil: enabling temporary routing rule to divert gold-tier burst traffic to silver model-variant (lower memory) to reduce hotpath pressure. rule applied: route(tier=gold, request.size>4096) -> model-variant=compact-v1.

jamie: dry-run logs for routing change:

```
# routing decisions
req_id=abc123 old=tier=gold route=hotpath-gpu-a new_route=compact-v1
req_id=abc124 old=tier=gold route=hotpath-gpu-a new_route=compact-v1
```

marta: after routing change and refill bump we see queue depth decreasing and P10 latency improving. still monitoring customer error rates.

oncall: good work. what's the root cause summary so far?

eli: tl;dr — new burstmeter rollout unintentionally lowered refill for gold tier in prod config. when traffic spiked, autoscaler attempted to scale but allocation quota hits prevented full recovery. tokenbucket refusal + allocation quota = prolonged queue and 429s.

sahil: impact: ~3 orgs saw 20-40% 429s for ~28 minutes. no data loss, only throttling. support already notified.

incidents-bot: update: postmortem checklist created and assigned to @jamie and @eli. action items due EOD.

jamie: short-term follow-ups (added to incident):
- validate burstmeter rollout gating to prevent low-refill values (jamie)
- add pre-deploy check for tokenbucket thresholds vs expected qps (marta)
- request quota increase or offer emergency allocation path for autoscaler (eli)
- add runbook step to fallback to silver routing when fill < threshold (sahil)

marta: i'm pushing a quick preflight check into CI: reject burstmeter rollout if any tier refill < 1.0 in prod config. will open PR now.

eli: infra quota team approved +4 nodes. pending cleanup after traffic normalizes.

sahil: updating status page: incident acknowledged -> mitigation in progress -> partial mitigation achieved. next update in 15.

[handoff to next oncall]

oncall: handing off to @jamie for escalation and postmortem. summary: tokenbucket misconfig (burstmeter) set gold refill too low during rollout; autoscaler limited by allocation quota; mitigations: token override, partial manual scale, routing diversion to compact-v1. 3 customers affected, 429s reduced to baseline.

jamie: thanks — i'll take it. i'll collect logs, timeline, and draft the postmortem. if anyone observes a regression re-open this thread.

incidents-bot: incident INC-2026-0421 status -> monitoring. incident reopened if 429 rate > baseline for 5m.

sahil: final note — please follow the runbook update: add an explicit autoscaler quota health check that prevents rollout promotion until preflight passes.

marta: copy. PR opened: https://git.redwood/burstmeter/preflight-checks/pull/432

eli: cleaning up manual nodes in 20m if traffic stable.

jamie: will own postmortem and customer RCA. thanks team. :heart:
